title: Icon Download: PNG, SVG, ICO & Cursor Files | Icons8
meta_description: Download icons in PNG, SVG, and ICO formats. Get cursor files and desktop icons. Choose your size and style, then download directly.
intro: Find the right file format for your project. Whether you need a scalable vector for web design or a specific file type for desktop applications, select the icon and download it in the format that fits your workflow.

sections.heading: Choose the Right File Format
paragraphs: Different projects require different file types. SVG files are best for web interfaces because they scale without losing quality. PNG files are standard for fixed-size graphics and work everywhere. ICO files are required for favicons and Windows application icons. Select the format that matches your technical requirements before downloading.
Some formats support transparency, while others do not. Check the preview to ensure the background fits your design. If you need to edit the icon later, vector formats provide the most flexibility.

sections.heading: Download Cursors and Desktop Icons
paragraphs: Standard icons are not always suitable for interactive elements. Cursor files need specific dimensions and formats to function correctly in operating systems. Desktop icons often require larger sizes and specific aspect ratios to look clear on a taskbar or desktop background.
Look for assets labeled as cursors or desktop icons. These are optimized for their specific use cases. Downloading a standard web icon for a cursor may result in poor performance or visual glitches.

sections.heading: Select Size and Style
paragraphs: Icons come in various visual styles, from flat and minimalist to detailed and 3D. Choose a style that matches your existing interface. Consistency in line weight and color palette makes your design look professional.
Size matters for usability. Small icons need simple shapes to remain recognizable. Larger icons can handle more detail. Preview the icon at the size you intend to use it to ensure clarity.

sections.heading: Check License Before Use
paragraphs: Every icon has a license attached to it. Some require attribution, while others allow commercial use without credit. Always review the license terms shown with the asset before downloading and using it in a project.
Ignoring license terms can lead to legal issues. Take a moment to verify that the license covers your intended use, whether it is for a personal project or a client website.

faq.question: Can I download icons in SVG format?
faq.answer: Yes, SVG files are available for most icons. They are ideal for web use because they scale to any size without pixelation.

faq.question: How do I download a cursor file?
faq.answer: Search for cursor-specific assets. These files are formatted correctly for operating systems to recognize them as interactive pointers.

faq.question: What is the difference between ICO and PNG for icons?
faq.answer: ICO files are the standard format for favicons and Windows desktop icons. PNG files are better for general web graphics and support transparency.

faq.question: Can I download icon packs?
faq.answer: Yes, you can download individual icons or look for sets that share a consistent style. This helps maintain visual coherence across your project.

faq.question: Do I need to attribute the icons?
faq.answer: It depends on the license. Check the license details provided with each icon to see if attribution is required for your use case.

faq.question: Are there desktop icons available for download?
faq.answer: Yes, there are icons optimized for desktop environments. These are often larger and designed to be clear at standard desktop resolutions.
